title: Visitor opens /admin
actual: /login?next=/admin (redirect correct; first automated check compared against the URL-encoded form)

title: Register with a 7-char password, browser check bypassed
actual: Password must be at least 8 characters.

title: Register with an existing email
expected: 'An account with this email already exists.'
actual: An account with this email already exists.

title: Log out, then open /admin
expected: Back on /, /admin asks to log in

title: Book list page 1
expected: 12 cards newest first ('To Kill a Mockingbird'), '36 books · page 1 of 3'
actual: 12 cards, first 'To Kill a Mockingbird', '36 books · page 1 of 3'

title: Open a book from list page 2
expected: Detail page of the same book: title, author, price, stock, description, product details

title: Click Back on the detail page
expected: Returns to /books?page=2 with the same books
actual: /books?page=2 – same first card (re-test with navigation wait). First automated run read the URL before client navigation finished.

title: Open a book from a filtered page 2 (maxPrice=250000) and go back
expected: Back keeps the filter and the page
actual: /books?maxPrice=250000&page=2 – same first card (re-test with navigation wait). First automated run read the URL before client navigation finished.

title: Non-existent book ID (/books/999999)
expected: Friendly 'We couldn't find that book' message, no crash, Back link

title: Invalid book ID (text) (/books/abc)
expected: Friendly 'We couldn't find that book' message, no crash, Back link

title: Soft-deleted book IDs (/books/37, /books/39)
expected: Friendly 'We couldn't find that book' message, no crash, Back link
actual: /books/37: HTTP 200, 'We couldn't find that book'; /books/39: HTTP 200, 'We couldn't find that book'

title: Detail uses the original image, list uses thumbnails (CR-04)
expected: Detail img = original-*; list cards = thumb-*.webp (or default)

title: Book without a cover (Cho Toi Xin Mot Ve Di Tuoi Tho)
Product details + disabled Add to cart (To Kill a Mockingbird)
expected: ISBN-13 and other details listed; Add to cart disabled with note (cart out of scope)

title: Detail page on a phone (iPhone SE)
Search Vietnamese title 'hoa vang'
expected: 1 result(s): ['Toi Thay Hoa Vang Tren Co Xanh']
actual: '1 book matching “hoa vang”' → ['Toi Thay Hoa Vang Tren Co Xanh']

title: Search with no match 'zzzzqq'
expected: 'No books match your search.' + 'Show all books'

title: Search with special characters '100%_off,(x)*'
expected: Treated as text, no error page

title: Filter by category 2 (Classics)
expected: 7 result(s): ['To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Nineteen Eighty-Four', 'Animal Farm', 'Pride and Prejudice', 'Emma']
actual: '7 books' → ['To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Nineteen Eighty-Four', 'Animal Farm', 'Pride and Prejudice', 'Emma']

title: Category 1 + price 100,000–150,000
expected: 2 result(s): ['Norwegian Wood', 'Toi Thay Hoa Vang Tren Co Xanh']
actual: '2 books · from 100.000 ₫ · up to 150.000 ₫' → ['Norwegian Wood', 'Toi Thay Hoa Vang Tren Co Xanh']

title: Boundary: min = max = 69000
actual: '1 book · from 69.000 ₫ · up to 69.000 ₫' → ['The Little Prince']

title: Reversed range min 150,000 > max 100,000 (swapped)
expected: 13 result(s): ['To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Nineteen Eighty-Four', 'Emma', 'The Hobbit', 'Foundation']
actual: '13 books · from 100.000 ₫ · up to 150.000 ₫ · page 1 of 2' → ['To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Nineteen Eighty-Four', 'Emma', 'The Hobbit', 'Foundation']

title: Search + category with no match: 'orwell' in Fiction
Pagination keeps filters (maxPrice=100000, 12 books)
expected: Next link keeps maxPrice; page 2 shows the rest
actual: next href=None; page2 titles=['Animal Farm', 'Pride and Prejudice', 'The Great Gatsby', 'Frankenstein', 'The Hound of the Baskervilles', 'The Alchemist', 'Cho Toi Xin Mot Ve Di Tuoi Tho', 'How to Win Friends and Influence People', 'The Little Prince', 'Matilda', 'Charlie and the Chocolate Factory', 'The BFG']

title: Use the filter panel: 'tolkien' + max 200,000 → Apply
Clear filters
actual: /books – "36 books · page 1 of 3" (re-test with navigation wait). First automated run read the URL before client navigation finished.

title: List page load time (3 cold loads, no cache, from the test server)
actual: load ms: [2074, 2136, 2328] – measured from a US test machine (x-vercel-id iad1::bom1: edge in Washington, function in Mumbai). Server TTFB 0.45–0.86 s. Must be re-measured from Vietnam (Chrome DevTools, Fast 4G) for the NFR evidence.
